title: Anne Carson wins Nobel Prize in literature 2026
summary: Anne Carson, acclaimed Canadian poet, translator, and essayist known for her innovative genre-blending works like 'Autobiography of Red', has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature.
